verdict.rationale: Mesh documents generating API credentials under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, with configurable permissions and an optional expiry date. Endpoint references also name the specific permissions they require, such as "Monitor and unmonitor customers" and "View roles in account", so a least-privilege credential can be scoped for an agent. Missing for 10: a documented full permission catalog or role-scoping details, revocation/rotation guidance, agent-specific credential identity, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
